name: Crashes & reliability
action: Reproduce the most common failure paths and prioritize a regression test.

name: Login & account access
action: Inspect authentication failures and test account recovery end to end.

name: Billing & subscriptions
action: Review billing evidence and clarify the relevant pricing or cancellation policy.

name: Speed & performance
action: Measure the slowest user journeys and investigate performance regressions.

name: Integrations & exports
action: Reproduce sync and export failures against the affected integration.

name: Navigation & usability
action: Run a usability review of the reported tasks and improve unclear labels.

name: Customer support
action: Audit unresolved support cases and improve routing for repeat questions.

name: Positive experience
action: Preserve the experience customers value and investigate opportunities to extend it.

name: Other feedback
action: Manually review these examples and add a more specific theme when justified.
